assertions: The handoff pilot remains default-off; disabled plans add no handoff edges and capture no worker output.
Enabled handoffs wait for successful terminal subagent registry records and use the captured real worker completion output.
Capture identity is bound to orchestration run, task graph, owner session, source task, source role, attempt, child run, and child session.
Cross-run, cross-session, cross-task, cross-role, cross-attempt, missing, malformed, and non-terminal output fails closed without latest-session fallback.
Delivered output is secret-redacted, capped at 8000 characters, hashed after redaction and truncation, and injected only as untrusted evidence.
A rejected or missing predecessor artifact prevents the dependent worker spawn and is exposed as explicit failure/risk evidence.
Spawn and completion result bundles, team_orchestrate, orchestrator.run, runtime blackboard, and observability trace surfaces carry explicit handoff state and provenance.
Two consecutive orchestration runs keep downstream prompts and replayed blackboard state isolated.
No direct worker-to-worker chat, permission grants, scope widening, or long-term memory write path was added.
uiImpact: No renderer-visible interaction changed; Electron E2E was not required. A production Vite/Electron build passed.

docsReview.reason: The READMEs do not document this default-off internal orchestration pilot.
